scripts.publish:query: cd packages/query && pnpm run build && cd dist && npm publish --access public
scripts.publish:query-react: cd packages/query-react && pnpm run build && cd dist && npm publish --access public
scripts.publish:db: cd packages/db && pnpm run build && cd dist && npm publish --access public
scripts.publish:store: cd packages/store && pnpm run build && cd dist && npm publish --access public
scripts.publish:store-react: cd packages/store-react && pnpm run build && cd dist && npm publish --access public
scripts.publish:packages: npm run publish:query && npm run publish:query-react && npm run publish:db && npm run publish:store && npm run publish:store-react
